component: Button variants (primary, destructive) and async action button
need: Distinguish the one primary action per view and destructive actions (Revoke, Void) in application UI; show in-progress state on submit without double submission.
workaround_r1: Use native button with text labels; confirm destructive actions via dialog (G-005); disable the button and show operation-status while pending. Acceptable for design; not for production visual hierarchy.
acceptance: data-forma-variant=primary|destructive styles exist in components.css outside the marketing scope; an aria-busy button state is styled and announced; axe passes.

component: Field invalid, disabled and read-only styling
need: Forms must show invalid fields and read-only policy values distinctly (G-012).
workaround_r1: validation-message text plus aria-invalid; the visual distinction relies on adjacent message text only.
acceptance: :disabled, :read-only, [aria-invalid=true] and :user-invalid styles exist in foundations.css with 3:1 non-text contrast; a browser test proves each.

component: Data table styling for plain table
need: Not required by release-1 designs: data-grid and dense-ledger cover all tables.
Not required by release 1: the exception inbox has no bulk actions by design (each decision is individual). One-click batch approval (RCD-005) is a single dialog listing items.

component: Visualization primitives and chart accessibility contract
need: Trend views for sponsor overview and investment performance (post release 1).
acceptance: A chart primitive with a mandatory text-table equivalent and axe-tested contrast.

component: Letter primitives (letterhead, address block, signature block)
workaround_r1: Compose from ef-print-header and ef-print-section with semantic address and paragraph markup (proven in design prototype D-001).
acceptance: Documented recipe or primitives with print-position rules for window envelopes (address block at a fixed position).

component: Verification code and document identity block
need: Each issued document shows its reference and a verification code or URL that resolves in the document registry (REQ-X-034).
workaround_r1: Text verification code inside ef-print-footer; QR code generation is Unbound-owned (SVG).
acceptance: Footer shows the reference and the verification URL; the registry resolves the hash.

component: Deterministic server-side PDF rendering (P2) and batch generation
need: Monthly statements for every fund, re-renderable byte-for-byte or with a stable content hash.
workaround_r1: Headless Chromium print-to-PDF from the Folio HTML (~0.25 s per document). Measured: per-page text hash stable 7/7; raw bytes identical 7/7 once /CreationDate and /ModDate are stripped, so the render service MUST set fixed metadata dates from the snapshot.
acceptance: Re-rendering the same snapshot yields an identical normalized content hash; throughput is measured.

component: Widget host, frame protocol and scoped tokens
workaround_r1: Plain iframe with server-issued short-lived token; no postMessage commands in release 1.
acceptance: CSP frame-ancestors restricted to registered partner origins; token TTL ≤ 10 minutes; no PII beyond the card.

need: 'Page n of N' on every page (D-002, all multi-page documents).
workaround_r1: Unbound render service injects the @page margin-box counter rule at render time (measured: passes 7/7 documents). Remove when Folio ships the rule.
acceptance: With no consumer CSS, ef-print-footer[repeat=page] containing ef-print-page-number[format=page-of-pages] yields 'Page n of N' on every body page in P1/P2 Chromium; P0 strict mode fails export instead of printing fallback text.

component: Running header/footer (repeat=page) and per-section running content
need: Reference (G-016), legal-sponsor disclosure (G-014) and verification code on every page; correct identity per document unit.
workaround_r1: Render-time @page margin boxes for reference and page number (measured 7/7); disclosure repeated in a final section; one document per PDF (no multi-unit PDFs) in release 1.
acceptance: Running slots print on every page of their profile, never fragment, reserve margin space, and can be set per section; pdftotext shows reference and disclosure on every page of a 70-row statement.

need: References, EINs, URLs and hashes must print and extract intact.
workaround_r1: Shorten verification URL to a short code plus registry host; put hashes in their own full-width row; accept wrapping of hashes in release 1.
acceptance: A primitive keeps identifiers of 32 characters or fewer and dates unbroken; pdftotext output of each identifier equals the source string.

component: Letter address block at fixed window-envelope position
workaround_r1: Release 1 delivers acknowledgments electronically (E-SIGN consent, counsel Q10); mailed letters use a fixed-height letterhead so the address lands in the window, verified per brand.
acceptance: An address primitive places its box at a configurable fixed page position (e.g. #10 window 0.875in/2.0in, 4.0x1.125in); pdftotext -bbox confirms for any letterhead length.

need: Statement grand totals must not repeat on every page (D-002).
workaround_r1: Move totals out of tfoot into a following summary block (ef-print-keep).
acceptance: ef-print-table[footer=final] prints tfoot only on the last fragment; carried-forward subtotal pattern documented and tested.

need: No orphaned headings above page breaks.
workaround_r1: Use the .ef-dense recipe on all Unbound documents (measured: no orphan).
acceptance: Component layer applies break-after: avoid to h1-h6 before blocks and tables; fixture shows no heading in the last 10% of a page.

need: Tables of contents with page numbers (D-002, D-006).
workaround_r1: Two-pass render in the Unbound render service fills data-page from the first-pass PDF; or omit page numbers in release 1.
acceptance: P2 export fills [data-page] from a first-pass layout; numbers match the PDF.

component: Tagged PDF in the P2 export contract
need: Distributed PDFs should be tagged; RCD-009 makes the HTML twin the accessible rendition.
workaround_r1: Render with Chromium tagged:true and outline:true (measured: Tagged: yes); HTML twin remains the conformance rendition.
acceptance: P2 pins tagged:true; structure validated by a PDF/UA checker (veraPDF or PAC) with documented limits.
Recipe with name, role, date and signature evidence, kept together, semantic dl, three documented examples.
